svg.text: Figure 3.5: Entity-Relationship Diagram – Core Relational Database Schema
Major Entities, Primary & Foreign Keys, Relational Associations, and Cardinalities
• Primary Keys (PK): Generated as Version-4 UUIDs ensuring collision-free globally unique identifiers across distributed nodes.
• Public Key Security: Asset table features non-guessable publicId UUIDs explicitly detached from internal database PKs for public QR verification URLs.
